svg.text: Optional. Nothing in this app requires one.
Kept in this browser only, never in the repository, and never sent anywhere until Cloud Suggestions is on.
OFF · SAVING A KEY DID NOT CHANGE THIS
Turning this on sends your task text to the Anthropic API.
The key is your own, kept on this device, and used for nothing else.
The Rule Engine remains the fallback and keeps working with no network.
Saving a key does not turn this on.
The Rule Engine is serving suggestions.
A key is saved, and Cloud Suggestions is off.
Turn Cloud Suggestions on above when you want the Model Engine.
The Fixture has not been scored yet.
When it is, per-field accuracy for both engines is published here
and in the repository — tags, priority, due date and summary separately.
The app does not claim the suggestions were right.
how long a completed task stays in its lists
no account, no sync, no second device
the date words and keyword tables are English
an open question, not a settled one
With Cloud Suggestions off: nothing, ever.
With it on: the text of the one task you are capturing, to the Anthropic API,
with your own key. No analytics, no telemetry, no third-party script.
You will not see it in capture or review. The Rule Engine answers instead,
with no error, banner or toast anywhere in the flow.
After a persistent failure a plain status appears here, and only here.
YOU ALWAYS SEE WHICH ONE SPOKE
THE FREE PATH IS THE REAL PRODUCT
The Rule Engine is not a fallback mode or a trial. It is what this app is, and it needs no key, no account and no network.
